ApiKey.description: API key for protected endpoints. Also accepted as Authorization: Bearer header.

operationalStatus.description: The official table is not a real-time operating-status feed.

get.summary: Multi-source realtime earthquake feed (past day M2.5+)
get.description: Server-side merge of the USGS GeoJSON feed with the local multi-source earthquake API (EMSC, P2PQuake, Wolfx, GEOFON); non-USGS events are injected as GeoJSON Features with properties.source attribution. 30-second in-memory cache; stale cache is served if all upstreams fail.
Proxies the USGS FDSN event query and merges matching events from the local multi-source API. 60-second server-side cache; responses carry Cache-Control: public, max-age=30.

get.summary: Response-corrected FDSN waveform package via ObsPy
get.description: Fetches StationXML response metadata with MiniSEED, removes the instrument response to acceleration in gal, and returns an auditable quake-sim-waveform-v1 package. Research readiness requires complete continuous three-component motion without delivery resampling. Rate-limited: 5 requests per minute per IP (spawns a Python subprocess).

200.description: quake-sim-waveform-v1 JSON; legacy data[] traces are retained

get.summary: SSE stream for real-time Japan earthquake data
get.description: Server-Sent Events stream. Sources: P2PQuake, Wolfx JMA EEW, Wolfx EqList, EMSC, JMA Atom Feed. Max 200 concurrent clients. Heartbeat every 30s.

get.summary: Realtime earthquake list from the local multi-source API
get.description: Proxies the local eq-collector (127.0.0.1:7891). 30-second server-side cache; stale cache is served when the upstream is down.
Proxies the local multi-source API. 120-second server-side cache; responses carry Cache-Control: public, max-age=60.
Proxies the local multi-source API. 300-second server-side cache; responses carry Cache-Control: public, max-age=120.

get.summary: Replay recorder status and event timeline index
get.description: Reports the in-memory replay ring (3 h retention, 20,000-frame cap), on-disk recording size, and a timeline index of up to 200 markers (one per EEW EventID plus felt 震度3+ 551 bulletins) scanned from the ring and the daily gzip files under recordings/. Cache-Control: no-cache.

earliest.description: Epoch ms of the oldest frame in the ring

latest.description: Epoch ms of the newest frame in the ring

get.summary: SSE replay of recorded realtime frames
get.description: Replays frames recorded from the live SSE hub as a per-client Server-Sent Events stream. Each frame is emitted as a named event (`event: <type>`) with data {type, event, replayTs}; the stream ends with `event: replay_end`. Max 20 concurrent replay clients (503 beyond that). Only the in-memory ring (3 h / 20,000 frames) is replayed.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Epoch ms; frames older than this are skipped. Defaults to the oldest frame in the ring.

get.summary: Download recorded frames for a time window (NDJSON)
get.description: Exports recorded frames as newline-delimited JSON (one {"t","type","event"} object per line), sourced from the daily gzip files plus the live ring. The window is clamped to the available recording range (daily files are kept 3 days); empty windows answer 204; windows over 6 hours are rejected with 400.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Window end, epoch ms (must be >= from; to - from <= 6 hours)

schema.description: One JSON object per line: {"t": epochMs, "type": string, "event": object}

204.description: No frames in the requested window

400.description: Missing/invalid from or to, or window larger than 6 hours

get.summary: NIED Kmoni (強震モニタ) station list proxy
get.description: Returns the NIED strong-motion monitor site list (upstream: Yahoo edge mirror of kmoni.bosai.go.jp SiteList/sitelist.json). Upstream response is cached server-side for 1 hour; responses carry Cache-Control: public, max-age=300. A stale cache entry is served when the upstream fetch fails; 502 when nothing is cached.

items.description: [lat, lng] pairs in sitelist order; indexes align with kmoni_rt intensity characters

get.summary: NIED official real-time intensity image proxy
get.description: Pre-rendered 強震モニタ RealTimeImg map frame (GIF/PNG). Candidate sources are probed in order (NIED new site, NIED legacy site, Yahoo mirror); the first working source is reused for 60 s. The image body is cached 5 s. When every source fails the endpoint backs off for 60 s, serving a stale frame when one is cached, otherwise 503 with Retry-After: 60.

X-Kmoni-Image-Source.description: Upstream source that produced this frame

get.summary: Wolfx NTP time proxy (client clock-offset calibration)
get.description: Proxies https://api.wolfx.jp/ntp.json. Cached server-side for 60 s; the stale cache is served on upstream errors, otherwise 502. Cache-Control: no-cache.

Proxies https://api.wolfx.jp/geoip.php, forwarding the client IP so the lookup describes the visitor rather than this server (loopback/private IPs use the server-side default). Used as the EEW countdown reference. Cache-Control: private, max-age=300; 502 when the upstream fails.

get.summary: Live multi-station seismogram proxy (open GSN data)
get.description: Serves decoded miniSEED STEIM1/2 traces for a frozen whitelist of four open GSN stations ringing Japan (IU MAJO/YSS/INCN/TATO, location 00, BHZ) from the EarthScope NGF FDSN dataselect service (anonymous open data, verified 2026-09-03). Traces are RAW INSTRUMENT COUNTS — no calibration applied. windowSec is quantised to 60 s steps in [60, 1200] (default 600). 30 s per-key LRU cache with stale-if-error up to 10 min; upstream 204 no-data is returned honestly (nodata=true, never a fabricated flat line). Per-IP token bucket 20 req/min. 403 for stations outside the whitelist, 502 when the upstream fails and no fresh-enough cache exists.

parameters.name: windowSec
parameters.description: Trace window length in seconds (quantised to 60 s steps)

403.description: Station not in the live-waveform whitelist

429.description: Too many live-waveform requests (20/min per IP)

502.description: Waveform source unavailable (no fresh-enough cached copy)

get.summary: Local settings: effective TTS upstream configuration
get.description: Public read of the effective TTS upstream configuration (no secrets: the settings-page API key is write-only). loopback reports whether this request comes from the local machine; tts.configurable is false when the TTS_UPSTREAM_URL environment variable pins the upstream. Cache-Control: no-cache.

post.summary: Local settings: update the TTS upstream / cloud key (loopback only)
post.description: Loopback-only (403 from remote addresses) so a remote visitor can never repoint the upstream (SSRF guard). Body fields: ttsUpstreamUrl (http(s) URL, or empty string to reset to the default), ttsApiKey (printable ASCII, empty string clears; write-only, never echoed), ttsApiKeyMode (query | bearer | x-api-key). Rate limit 10/min per IP.

get.summary: Full preset earthquake catalog with metadata
get.description: Returns all 15 preset earthquakes with focal mechanisms, observation city lists, and max observed Shindo.

get.summary: Available TTS voice metadata (fragment packs + neural synthesis voices)
get.description: voices lists the pre-generated fragment packs; neuralVoices lists the 11 voices accepted by /api/v1/tts/synthesize.

get.summary: Synthesize a complete neural TTS announcement
get.description: Returns audio/mpeg. Anonymous traffic is rate-limited to 60 requests per minute per client IP; authenticated API keys (?key= or Bearer) get 240 requests per minute with per-key usage metering. text is limited to 300 characters. Identical voice+text pairs are served from a bounded server-side LRU cache (X-TTS-Cache).

400.description: Missing text, excessive length, or unsupported voice

post.summary: Synthesize a complete neural TTS announcement (JSON body)
post.description: Same as GET but takes parameters as a JSON body — preferred for long non-ASCII texts. Same rate limits and cache apply.

400.description: Missing text, excessive length, unsupported voice, or invalid JSON

post.summary: Build TTS fragment playlist from earthquake parameters
post.description: Rate-limited: 10 requests per minute per IP. Use ?text=0 query param to omit the text field from fragments.

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: Set to 0 to omit text field from fragments

get.description: Rate-limited: 1 request per second per IP (excess returns current value without increment).

post.summary: Inject test earthquake into SSE stream
post.description: Rate-limited: 10 requests per minute per IP; body capped at 64KB.

400.description: Invalid parameters (max 10 hooks, duplicate URL, invalid events)

post.description: Client-side trigger that fans a simulation.complete event out to all subscribed webhooks.

post.summary: Inject a test JMA EEW frame into the SSE stream (debug)
post.description: Broadcasts a raw Wolfx-shaped jma_eew frame (isTraining=true by default) so EEW clients can be exercised without a live warning. Rate-limited: 10 requests per minute per IP; body capped at 64KB. Intended for testing/debugging, like /api/v1/test/earthquake.
Rate-limited: 3 registrations per hour per IP.
Rate-limited: 5 failed attempts per 15 minutes per IP. The token is valid for 24 hours.

200.description: Key list ({keys: [{id (prefix), key (masked), label, created, lastUsed, requestCount}]}). Full key material is only returned once, at creation — keys are stored hashed.

400.description: Maximum 10 keys reached, or invalid JSON

delete.summary: Delete one of the developer's API keys
delete.description: The path parameter is the key prefix id (as returned in id by GET /api/v1/dev/keys).

get.summary: Usage summary for the developer's keys

200.description: Usage summary ({username, keyCount, totalRequests, todayRequests, weekRequests}; daily/weekly figures are approximations)

get.summary: Server health check (realtime feed state + uptime)
get.description: 200 when at least one realtime feed (P2PQuake, Wolfx EEW, Wolfx EqList, EMSC) is connected, 503 when all are down. Cache-Control: no-cache. Note: this endpoint lives at the server root, not under /api/.

200.description: At least one realtime feed is connected

503.description: All realtime feeds down (same JSON body, status=degraded)
